_comment: OpenAI Foundation grants. Two programmes report differently: AI Resilience grants are announced individually (only the SecureBio one carries a public figure so far; the Foundation says >$130m is being finalised), while the People-First AI Fund named 208 nonprofits but published only the $40.5m pool. The 208 therefore carry no amount and the pool sits on one aggregate row, so nothing is double counted. Not yet itemised anywhere public: the rest of AI Resilience, the $100m Life Sciences tranche, and the $9.5m People-First second wave.

grants.description: Cutting end-to-end pathogen detection from fourteen days to three, expanding collection, and further validating the detection system. Restricted to SecureBio's Detection team.
